empty: Convert your input to see the result.
privacy: Processed on your device. Nothing is uploaded or saved.
limits: Up to 1 MiB per input. One value per conversion.
extendedHelp: Enable to encode typed wrappers such as $binary and $integer. Decoding always labels values that JSON cannot represent.
typedOutput: This result uses typed wrappers. Enable Extended JSON when encoding it back.
workerError: Conversion could not finish. Try a smaller input.
timeoutError: Conversion took too long. Try a smaller input.
helpText: Hex, Base64 and Base64URL represent bytes; they are not additional serialization formats. JSON numbers use IEEE 754; integer literals keep every digit.
helpTypes: Typed output: $binary (Base64), $integer (decimal string), $float (NaN, Infinity, -Infinity or -0), $undefined, $cborTag ([number, value]), and $msgpackExt ([type, Base64]). These wrappers are tool conventions, not standard JSON types.
helpLimits: Re-encoding preserves supported values, not necessarily identical bytes. CBOR simple values and indefinite-length strings are unsupported. MessagePack maps require string keys; duplicate keys are rejected. Streams and schema-based formats are outside this tool.
helpCollision: Extended JSON reserves objects with a single wrapper key. Keep it off for literal JSON objects containing those keys. CBOR maps with non-string keys or wrapper-shaped objects are shown as $map entry pairs.
